tools.name: find_solutions
tools.description: Match a task to saved infrastructure evidence. Returns interpreted requirements, relevant task guides, source dates, matching options and unresolved requirements. Inspect unresolved requirements before choosing.

tools.name: get_setup_instructions
tools.description: Read copyable setup instructions for one published provider, with current source review status and original documentation links. Review unconfirmed documentation before acting.

tools.name: list_categories
tools.description: List published category IDs with source links, saved claim/test dates and research limits.

tools.name: search_providers
tools.description: Literal, case-insensitive search of published provider IDs, names and descriptions in alphabetical order. Empty query lists providers. Returns dated summaries with source links and limits; at most 20 per page.

tools.name: get_provider
tools.description: Read one published provider: claims, independent confirmation/review dates, free access, saved test schedule, results link and related dated task guides. No live checks or vendor execution.

tools.name: get_free_tier
tools.description: Read the published free-tier offers, including unknown eligibility, card rules, source/check dates and limits. At most 20 offers per page; optionally filter by category.

tools.name: get_benchmark_board
tools.description: Read the latest saved browser or sandbox board exactly as published, with mixed dates, sample counts, source links and original limits. No new measurements or recalculation.
